run.host: Node v26.13.0; immutable native PDF text/graphics replay; no Zotero or DOM
run.protocol: Production local rules and object grouping, full unrotated native capture. PDF identity is checked against capture metadata, not by rereading PDF bytes. Duration is grouping replay only, excluding native extraction, bundling and Reader initialization. Optional diagnostics add observer cost. No gold geometry is used as rule input. Selected checks do not measure exhaustive precision, complete crop fidelity or Zotero task success.

findings.body: Baseline cuts off the right-hand computation-time column and entire privacy-loss column, and excludes the complete top rule. V2 restores all five columns, all four procedure rows, equations, outer horizontal rules and vertical separators; it adds only this table content and surrounding whitespace, not the ordinary paragraphs below.
findings.caption: Exact baseline and v2 caption rectangles and crop hashes are identical; complete Table 1 caption remains separate above the table.
findings.ownership: The newly included right-hand material belongs to the same Table 1, not an unrelated object or prose.
findings.bodyGeometryComparison: Changed numerically and visually inspected; not inferred from score.
findings.priorCropDefect: Baseline retained-pass table body was horizontally incomplete; v2 corrects it in this reviewed crop.

findings.body: The actual group with a body contains the full learning-rate plot, all three curves, axes/ticks, time and log-scale learning-rate labels, and held-out-likelihood legend. Exact baseline/v2 body rectangles and crop hashes are equal; both were viewed against the original page.
findings.caption: The genuine eight-line Figure 1 caption immediately under the plot is intact, exact baseline/v2 rectangles and hashes equal. It is distinct from the narrative paragraph lower on the page.
findings.ownership: No added prose or unrelated right-column graphical model in the actual body-bearing group.
findings.bodyGeometryComparison: Selected the sole body-bearing member of the two-element predicted array by body presence and verified on the source page; did not choose by array index or score.

findings.body: Additional metadata review: baseline has outer body local:1:body:1 plus strictly-contained local:1:body:2. V2 retains the outer member and removes only the contained member. Source page and exact old/new body crops show the same complete two-sided notation table, all seven rows and ruled frame; both crop hashes equal.
findings.caption: Exact old/new caption rectangles and crop hashes equal; the Table 1 caption is intact.
findings.ownership: Removed member covered already-owned interior table content, not a separate authored object. Surviving outer body still owns the entire table; no prose ownership added.
findings.bodyGeometryComparison: Compared membership lists and exact numeric union, and independently viewed old/new union crops; not inferred from equal IoU.
